title: Quarto page front matter
description: The front matter of a .qmd or .md page. It lists Quarto's common keys; add the keys your site uses, each with a description, or put them under metadata.

abstract.description: A short summary shown above the page, instead of the body.

author.description: The page's author or authors: a name, an object of author details, or a list of either.

authors.description: The page's authors, as names or objects of author details.

bibliography.description: The citation database file or files, such as references.bib.

categories.description: The categories the page belongs to, for listing pages on the site.

code-fold.description: true or show hides code in a foldable block; false shows it.

code-line-numbers.description: true numbers the lines of code blocks on the page.

csl.description: The citation style file or name, such as a .csl file.

description.description: One sentence about the page, for search results and link previews.

draft.description: true keeps the page out of the built site until it is published.

echo.description: true or false shows or hides code blocks, leaving the output.

engine.description: The execution engine for code blocks, such as knitr or jupyter.

execute.description: Execution settings for the page's code blocks: echo, warning, freeze, and their like.

fig-align.description: Where figures sit on the page.

format.description: The output format for this page alone, when not the site default.

freeze.description: true keeps computed output, so a page renders without running its code again.

image.description: The image for link previews, as a path from the page.

image-alt.description: The text that describes the preview image.

keywords.description: Keywords for search engines and related pages.

lang.description: The page's language as a tag such as en or fa-IR.

lightbox.description: true opens images in a lightbox when a reader clicks them.

page-layout.description: How the page is laid out: article, full, or custom.

subtitle.description: A second line under the title.

title.description: The page title, shown in the heading, the browser tab, and lists.

toc.description: true shows a table of contents beside the page.

toc-depth.description: The deepest heading level the table of contents lists.

toc-location.description: Which side the table of contents sits on.

warning.description: true or false shows or hides warnings from code blocks.
